lines.japanese:
灰野耕一郎。
　４２歳。
　日本国籍。
　
　旧環境組織化委員会に所属していた選任被験者。
lines.english: Kouichirou Haino. Age forty-two. Japanese citizen.  A designated test subject formerly attached to the Environmental Organization Committee.

hyperlinks.preview: The former Environmental Organization Research Committee.

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: The former Environmental Organization Research Committee.

lines.japanese:
最初期のＵＳＥＲの一人で、ユーラシア大陸の某発
展途上国にて実施された都市実験に関係。
　世論により国内研究が縮小されると同時に、委員会
からの要請を受け渡米。
　米国の提携研究機関に移籍する。
lines.english: One of the earliest USERs, he was involved in an urban experiment conducted in an unnamed developing country on the Eurasian continent. When public opinion led to a reduction in research at home, he moved to the United States at the committee's request and transferred to an American partner institution.

lines.japanese:
自らが重要被験者でありながら、派生現象学の発展
に寄与。
　群像委員会の立ち上げに関与。
lines.english: Though an important test subject himself, he contributed to the development of derivative phenomenology and participated in founding the Ensemble Committee.

lines.japanese:
現在は防衛施設庁第二施設部に所属。
　ＧＶＰの実現のため、群像委員会と歩調を取る。
lines.english: He currently serves in the Second Facilities Department of the Defense Facilities Administration Agency and coordinates with the Ensemble Committee to bring the GVP to fruition.

lines.japanese:
また現象行使者としての能力も優秀であり、米国
では要人警護経験を持つ。
lines.english: He is also an accomplished phenomenon operator, with experience protecting dignitaries in the United States.
